commentary.text: 90+10' Jose Sanchez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+9' Flag up against Artem Dovbyk (Girona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90+9' Juanpe (Girona) bangs in a header at goal from near the penalty spot after a decent cross, but it lacks power and accuracy and spins well past the left post.
90+6' Juanpe (Girona) reacts well near the penalty spot to connect with the resulting corner, but fails to direct his header into the back of the net. The ball goes well wide of the left post.
90+6' Aleix Garcia (Girona) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
90+5' The linesman makes the right call and Girona will have a corner.

90+4' Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the roof of the net that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
90+4' Savio (Girona) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Unai Simon is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
90+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
90+2' Girona earn a corner.
90+2' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but misses to the right of the target.
90' We will have 9 min. of added time.
90' Aleix Garcia (Girona) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
89' Funez Salva prepares a substitution. Yangel Herrera is replaced by Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Cristhian Stuani (Girona) coming on for Viktor Tsygankov.
89' Rough tackle by Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. Girona have a free kick.
88' The Girona players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
86' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to substitute Benat Prados Diaz and he is replaced by Mikel Vesga (Ath Bilbao).
86' Yeray Alvarez goes off the pitch and Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) comes on.
85' The total number of attempts is 13:6.
84' Excellent touch by Savio (Girona)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
83' The game is interrupted as Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) is flagged offside.
82' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
77' Referee Jose Sanchez signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Girona players have a reason to celebrate!
76' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible offside. The Girona players aren’t happy.

75' 3 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Aleix Garcia flights the free kick into the box, where Eric Garcia (Girona) peels off his marker and heads it low into the centre of the goal from the edge of the six-yard box. He makes it 3:2.
75' It seemed like Aleix Garcia (Girona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
74' Substitution. Arnau Martinez walks off the pitch and Valery (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
74' Substitution. Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) on for Unai Gomez.
74' Funez Salva decides to make a substitution. Ivan Martin will be replaced by Portu (Girona).
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is coming onto the pitch as Gorka Guruzeta cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
73' Yangel Herrera (Girona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
69' None of the Ath Bilbao players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
69' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Ath Bilbao get a corner.
68' Yangel Herrera (Girona) tries to find Viktor Tsygankov, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
66' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Girona was in an offside position.

64' Paulo Gazzaniga was forced into action to thwart Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom left corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
62' Jose Sanchez couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) and blew his whistle.
60' 3 - 1 Goal! Some very poor defending from the opponent allows Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) the chance to get to the edge of the box and he makes no mistake with a lovely finish. It's 3:1.
60' The ball possession at the moment is 33:67.
58' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) makes a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.

56' 2 - 1 Goal! Gorka Guruzeta produces a great pass that finds Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a low shot into the back of the net. 2:1.
56' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
54' Eric Garcia (Girona) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle.
53' Savio (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
52' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) commits a foul and Jose Sanchez immediately signals a free kick.
52' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!

49' 1 - 1 Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Ivan Martin, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 1:1.
48' Savio (Girona) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Unai Simon pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
46' Referee Jose Sanchez blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Yeray Alvarez (Ath Bilbao) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting set piece and aims a header towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes and makes a superb save.
45+2' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) steps up to send the ball in.
45+1' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Ath Bilbao.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 4:3.
43' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga is prepared to thwart his effort.

41' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging. The ball goes out of play and Girona will have a goal kick.
40' Aleix Garcia (Girona) brings an opponent down and Jose Sanchez interrupts the game.
37' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
35' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.

34' Artem Dovbyk sprays a wonderful pass out to Yangel Herrera (Girona), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Unai Simon problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
33' A cross into the box from Savio (Girona) is cleared.
31' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
31' Inigo Lekue is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao).
29' Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
28' Girona control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
27' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
25' Eric Garcia (Girona) picked up a yellow card from referee.
25' The referee shows the yellow card to Inigo Lekue (Ath Bilbao).
25' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) muscles his way past two defenders but his shot from inside the box smashes against the right post!
21' Yangel Herrera (Girona) commits a rough challenge and Jose Sanchez blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Having seen unsporting behavior, Jose Sanchez shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Martin Juan Carlos (Girona) is the recipient.
19' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) tries a pot shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly wide of the left post.
16' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 22:78.
11' Viktor Tsygankov nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Artem Dovbyk (Girona), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
10' Girona take a short corner kick.

9' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Unai Simon, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The referee points to the corner flag and Girona will take a corner.
8' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Gorka Guruzeta and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
7' The ball is cleared after Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
4' Savio (Girona) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
2' 1 - 0 GOAL! Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets to the ball on the edge of the box after a huge mistake by an opponent and slams it into the back of the net. He makes it 1:0.
1' Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) makes a strong challenge and Jose Sanchez blows for a foul.
